ui_finding: UI DIFFERS from old KB (knowledge/portal-fonts.md, store linh-tib-staging, 2026-09-09): clicking 'Upload fonts' on THIS store opens a MODAL dialog ('Browse fonts to upload:' + 'Choose File' button + note 'Convert font into TTF before uploading (Online converter)' linking to transfonter.org), not a direct OS file picker with no modal. Inside the modal, 'Choose File' opens the native OS file chooser; selecting a file uploads automatically (no separate explicit submit/upload button observed) and the file appears under a 'New fonts' section with a status icon. This may be a genuine behavior difference between stores/versions, or the old KB observation was incomplete — recorded as-is per current_behavior_only, not resolved as conflict since old evidence is from a different store.
